title: Keep Recent Conversation History Within a Token Budget
prompt:
Implement ConversationHistory with add(role, content) and get_recent(max_tokens) -> list[tuple[str, str]]. add appends one message chronologically. A message's token count is len(content.split()); its role does not count toward the budget. get_recent returns the longest contiguous suffix of messages whose total token count is at most max_tokens, preserving chronological order. If the newest message alone exceeds the budget, return an empty list.

Roles are nonempty strings and contents are strings. max_tokens is a nonnegative ordinary integer. Invalid inputs raise ValueError. Treat whitespace-only content as a zero-token message and preserve its original content in the returned tuple. Aim for O(log n + output size) per read after maintaining cumulative token counts.

example.input: history.add('user', 'one two'); history.add('assistant', 'three'); history.add('user', 'four five'); history.get_recent(3)
example.reasoning: The latest two messages use exactly three tokens, while including the prior message would exceed the budget.
